operational_note: urllib timeout=60 is a socket-operation timeout, not a guaranteed 60-second total wall-clock deadline. The runner labels this honestly in run_metadata. Raw completed/empty/incomplete/HTTP/network failures must remain in assigned-model records; no retry-until-success.
